race.comment: GILGEOUS (9) looks the one best set up to win at his third career start. He was beaten a long neck on debut at Echuca then just found a short-priced favourite a touch too strong here last time. Should be fitter again now and expect Dee to find the front and prove too strong. CERTAINLY QUIET (4) resumes. She was knocking on the door before the break with four minor placings in a row, including a narrow defeat in the G3 SA Fillies Classic. This is a good trip to kick off at and she should go well. ZOUCITY (11) has been thereabouts in all three runs to date, the past two in town and is suited back a notch. SOARING LEGEND (10) first-starter by Grunt out of Isobel's Locket. Has had seven hit-outs leading into this, the latest when fourth in a Flemington jump-out. Yard has a strong strike rate with debutantes. Watch betting.
